sanskrit: सर्वदा सर्वभावानां सामान्यं वृद्धिकारणम् । ह्रासहेतुर्विशेषश्च प्रवृत्तिरुभयस्य तु ॥
iast: sarvadā sarvabhāvānāṃ sāmānyaṃ vṛddhikāraṇam | hrāsahetur viśeṣaś ca pravṛttir ubhayasya tu ||
meaning_en: SAMPLE - Dr. Manash to write/verify: Similarity (samanya) always causes increase of all entities, and dissimilarity (vishesha) causes their decrease.
